overview: The Committee of the Whole received a presentation and held a discussion on the Affordable Housing Linkage Nexus Study report, which analyzes potential fees on non-residential development to fund affordable housing.

items.title: Affordable Housing Linkage Nexus Study Presentation
items.summary: Consultant Carl Seidman presented findings establishing a legal basis for a maximum linkage fee of $34.75 per square foot, while recommending a lower rate of $5 to $8 to maintain Medford's economic competitiveness. The council discussed project thresholds, investor return impacts, and whether to pursue a fee higher than the recommended range.
